RFSweepStatsSettings.description: Defines the names of the columns in the data-record.

names.description: How long to wait before starting the sweep (in seconds).

initial_wait.description: Warm up time before the measurement starts (in seconds).

minimum_wait.description: Minimum time to wait before stability tests are allowed to pass (in seconds).

use_traditional_stats.description: If True, use kendal test and runs test to check stability.

stats_window.description: Thermopile voltage must be stable over this time period to proceed to the next frequency (in seconds).

stats_Rcv.description: Used by runs test. Hiher = more stringent test.

stats_Tcv.description: Used by Kendall test. Higher = more stringent.

measurement_interval.description: Thermopile voltage sampling interval for computing stability stats in seconds.
